title: Build synchronized launch timeline and stakeholder roleplay feedback loop for release notes
creator: Aisha Raman
description: Create a repeatable, low-friction process and artifacts to draft customer-facing changelogs and the internal stakeholder brief for releases. Focus is on synchronizing timelines across PM, Eng, Design, Docs, Support, and Legal; introducing live roleplay sessions to validate messaging and rollback scripts; and producing a single source-of-truth artifact with links to PRs, evaluation dashboards, and redaction guidelines.
objectives: Define a shared timeline template that aligns drafting, reviews, and publishing windows
Create a roleplay-based review ritual to simulate customer questions and ops responses
Produce templated changelog entries and internal one-pagers for tiered audiences
Ensure traceability: link release notes to PRs, evals, and post-launch monitoring dashboards
Document redaction and localization steps to support enterprise requirements
rollout_plan: Week -2: PM draft seeded with engineering PR links and impact summary
Week -1: Cross-functional review (Eng, Design, Docs, Support, Legal) in two passes: technical accuracy, then tone & external comms
Day -3: Roleplay rehearsal (30-45m) with Support and SEs simulating inbound customer questions
Day -1: Final signoff from product lead and legal; create embargoed release package
Day 0: Publish staged changelog: public short summary + expanded tiered notes + admin-only operational playbook

review_comments: Priya Shah (Eng): 'Add exact rollback command and expected state after rollback; include latency regressions if observed.'

decisions: Adopt a two-stage review window (technical accuracy, then messaging/tone) for all public changelogs
Use an embargoed Google Doc as the single source-of-truth until final signoff
Mandate a 30-45 minute roleplay rehearsal for releases that have customer-facing behavioral changes
Publish a three-tier changelog format: 1) one-line summary, 2) expanded public notes, 3) admin/ops playbook
